## Branch against blend, under every cost model

Positive means the blend costs more. `flat` reproduces the table in *Branch against blend*;
`cycles` is time under `Cached` and `LatencyModel::Modelled` rather than issue capacity.

| Case | Route | Triangles | flat | coalesced | cached | cycles |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| small, spread over the frame | tiled | 16 | +1.6% | +20.2% | +32.5% | +17.7% |
| small, spread over the frame | raytrace | 16 | +4.4% | +74.8% | +92.2% | +57.6% |
| full-frame, stacked | walk | 16 | +1.9% | +26.4% | +42.9% | +17.4% |
| full-frame, stacked | tiled | 16 | +1.9% | +27.3% | +45.4% | +24.0% |
| full-frame, stacked | raytrace | 16 | +2.5% | +31.8% | +37.1% | +32.5% |
